high_level_description: The image depicts the demolition of a building that appears to be part of the White House complex. The structure is partially collapsed, with debris scattered around the site. A large excavator is actively engaged in the demolition process, indicating ongoing work. Several workers wearing high-visibility vests can be seen near the machinery, suggesting they are involved in the demolition or cleanup efforts. The text overlay at the bottom of the image reads: "Google, Apple, Microsoft, Meta among tech giants donating to Trump’s $300 million White House ballroom project.
